title: Redundant .unwrap() after .is_none() guard in config validators
description: In both transit/src/config.rs and reader/src/config.rs, the Azure and GCS validation arms do: if backend.azure.is_none() { return Err(...) } let azure = backend.azure.as_ref().unwrap(). The unwrap is guaranteed safe by the guard, but a reviewer must reason through this. Rewrite: use 'let Some(azure) = backend.azure.as_ref() else { return Err(...) }' — eliminates the unwrap, makes the guard and binding explicit in one expression.
